§e§lDO THIS§r
§b1.§r Water into the silo face's §bH2O§r Input Hatch - the Input Hatch on the drum course, beside the Silo Control Block. §8Step 4 has the drawn map.§r
§b2.§r Set Control Rods 1-24 in the GUI. 24 is full campaign power. §8A programmed circuit in the controller slot overrides the field.§r
§b3.§r Enable the controller.

With no turbine chain behind it the plant simply §bexports Reactor Steam§r through the silo face's OUT hatch - or Hot Coolant, if you feed it IC2 Coolant instead of water. That is honest power, and it is a fraction of what this plant can do.

§c§lTHE REACTOR NEVER DRAWS EU§r
Nothing on the ten-step path needs to be powered. Unit One generates; it does not consume - the reactor, the spine, the chamber and the gallery draw nothing at all, not idling, not starting, not running - and the four Energy Hatches in step 9 are §bnot a structure requirement§r: this plant forms and runs perfectly well without a single one of them.

§6§lTWO THINGS ON THIS CAMPUS DO DRAW EU. BOTH ARE OPTIONAL MODULES.§r
The §bExtraction Derrick§r (§21,920 EU/t§r) and the §bEnrichment Annex§r (§2480 EU/t§r) take their power §bthrough those same four Energy Hatches§r and from nowhere else. Build either one and the hatches stop being furniture: fit at least one and §bwire it to a live grid§r, or that module silently never turns over. Their blueprints are on the bottom row and both say so at the top.

§e§lREAD IT ANYWHERE§r
The §bSilo Control Block§r prints the same instrument panel the GUI does. So does the Turbine Control Block, and so does a Portable Scanner. §8One panel, everywhere - no readout can disagree with another.§r

§a§lDONE WHEN§r
A §bWater Bucket§r is in your inventory. §8That is the whole gate - a quest reads your pack, not your plant. A bucket PRIMES the feedwater hatch; a reactor that is actually running wants a real water line behind it.§r

§e§lCHECK YOUR WORK§r
The REACTOR group shows live pillars and a non-zero §2L/t steam§r, and OUTPUT reads §2Steam export§r with a real number.

[note]Feedwater is NOT coolant. The hatch you just filled is the SILO's. The Spiral chamber has its own §bCOOL§r hatch, on a different building, and neither can drink the other's fluid. §cStep 8 is where that one has to be fed§r - until it is, the turbine never leaves 0 RPM.[/note]

[warn]Every shutdown leaves DECAY HEAT: twenty minutes of mandatory cooling water. It is deferred, never waived. "Written in Fire" has the details.[/warn]
